location.background_limits_title: How Location Tracking Works on Phones
location.background_limits_desc: A web app or PWA gets GPS positions only while it is open. For the most reliable tracking, install the app to the phone Home Screen and keep the screen awake with Guardian mode. When the phone is locked or the browser is minimized, Android and iOS stop timers and location fixes. For guaranteed 24/7 background tracking with the phone locked, install our native Android companion app with background location permissions.
